SELECT ssu.id, ssu.emp_no, ssu.emp_name, ssu.user_name, sem.phone_no, sem.email, sem.org_name, ssu.update_time, ssu.power_factory_id, IFNULL(role_data.role_id, '') AS role_id, IFNULL(dept_data.department_id, '') AS department_id, IFNULL(role_data.role_names, '') AS role_names, IFNULL(factory_data.factory_names, '') AS factory_names, IFNULL(dept_data.depart_name, '') AS depart_name FROM safety_sys_user ssu -- 改成 LEFT JOIN 保证用户一定出现 LEFT JOIN safety_employee_message sem ON ssu.emp_no = sem.emp_no
-- 【修复】角色子查询：把 WHERE 条件移动到 ON 里，不丢失用户 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ssur.user_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ssr.id SEPARATOR ',') AS role_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ssr.role_name SEPARATOR ',') AS role_names FROM safety_sys_user_role ssur LEFT JOIN safety_sys_role ssr ON ssur.role_id = ssr.id AND ssr.delete_falg = "0" -- 关键修复 GROUP BY ssur.user_id ) role_data ON ssu.id = role_data.user_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT factory_name SEPARATOR ',') AS factory_names FROM ytsafety_sys_user_factory GROUP BY user_id ) factory_data ON ssu.id = factory_data.user_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT depart_id SEPARATOR ',') AS department_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT depart_name SEPARATOR ',') AS depart_name FROM ytsafety_sys_user_depart GROUP BY user_id ) dept_data ON ssu.id = dept_data.user_id
WHERE ssu.delete_falg = 0
AND
FIND_IN_SET(#{item}, dept_data.department_id)
AND ssu.emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.empName}, '%')
AND ssu.emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.empNo}, '%')
AND sem.phone_no = #{dto.phone}
AND
FIND_IN_SET(#{item}, role_data.role_id)
ORDER BY ssu.update_time DESC

-- 【修复】角色子查询：把 WHERE 条件移动到 ON 里，不丢失用户 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ssur.user_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ssr.id SEPARATOR ',') AS role_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ssr.role_name SEPARATOR ',') AS role_names FROM safety_sys_user_role ssur LEFT JOIN safety_sys_role ssr ON ssur.role_id = ssr.id AND ssr.delete_falg = "0" and ssr.role_type = 2 -- 关键修复 GROUP BY ssur.user_id ) role_data ON ssu.id = role_data.user_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT factory_name SEPARATOR ',') AS factory_names FROM ytsafety_sys_user_factory GROUP BY user_id ) factory_data ON ssu.id = factory_data.user_id
